title: The Brined Deep Where Memory Crystallizes

features.name: the salt-memory formation
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of crystal where information compressed into mineral form. Each layer is a different pressure, a different moment. The surface glitters with old tears.

features.name: the brine-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of saturated memory-liquid. It is denser than water, heavier than thought. Things that fall into it surface years later, transformed.

features.name: the pressure-registry
features.desc-on-touch: A chip rendered in the render's cold palette. It measures the weight of all memory above, translating compression into numbers the terminal can understand.

features.name: crystallized moments
features.desc-on-touch: A filecard arranged like a directory listing. Each line is a moment that has become permanent, sharp, impossible to soften or reinterpret.

features.name: the arch of pressure
features.desc-on-touch: The space between two stone faces where the deep is learning to hold itself. The arch is made of compressed thought, bearing the weight of all that sits above.

features.name: the clarity-paradox
features.desc-on-touch: The deeper you go, the more clearly you see what was lost in the compression. The saltwater shows you everything with impossible detail.

inscription: salt remembers every tear that made it; pressure is another word for clarity

file.name: Deep_Brine_Compression_Analysis_1991.txt
file.note: Core sample analysis from 400 meters depth. Each salt layer contains trace compounds: ink, pollen, copper wire, paper fiber, bird bone. The sample seems to contain memory from multiple centuries compr
